title: Glory to God in the Highest

request.style: English, Baroque oratorio, a soprano recitative over harpsichord telling the story, then a bright chorus with trumpets, strings and timpani, sparkling and festive, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
There were shepherds abiding in the field
Keeping watch over their flock by night
And the angel of the Lord came upon them
And the glory of the Lord shone round about them

[Verse]
Fear not, for behold, I bring you good tidings
Of great joy for all the people
For unto you is born this day in the city of David
A Savior, who is Christ the Lord

[Chorus]
Glory to God in the highest
And peace on earth to all with whom he is pleased
Glory to God in the highest
And peace on earth

[Outro]
Glory to God in the highest
